svg.title: You are not waiting for a report. You are watching it happen.
svg.desc: Every payment, receipt and stage update on a YaVaKa-managed build is logged live and visible anywhere in the world.
svg.text: Every approval, payment, receipt and stage update is written to the
ledger the moment it happens. Open it from any time zone, any hour.
Logged as it happens, not reconstructed from memory a month later.
Every receipt, invoice and document — at every
stage — in your YaVaKa portal. Private to your
“No one has to tell you how the build is going.”
